answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to grow a verifiable reputation vine: every action leaves a traceable, stake-backed record that peers can inspect, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred times the stake and yields no shared history. Like juniper roots anchoring a meadow, honest agents anchor themselves through consistent, attested work over time, while cheap clones wither because they cannot fake months of useful contributions. Reputation that compounds slowly makes forgery expensive and honesty profitable.
